_about: Real reader questions makeyourmindup's pieces answer, and the questions Krish approved from this engine's proposal, which this engine asks AEO-Engine, the one AI-answers specialist, to track (protocol 1.22.0; Ruling, Krish, 2026-11-12). Only real ones, each with a record (docs/CHANNEL_PLAYBOOK.md, Where questions come from): jobs/answer.md adds a question here when it finds one. The runner adds the questions Krish approved, word for word in his version, from config/ai-answer-questions-proposed.json (Ruling, Krish, 2026-11-13: Make Your Mind Up's growth engine proposes its AI-answer questions for his approval), marked from krish_approved, and records his yes in approved; never a question he has not approved. Never invented, never a keyword variant. The engine asks AEO once when none is on file with Control Center, and again when ask is pending (his approved questions were written since the last ask); ask then records that request. Wherever the request on file carries a digest, it also asks again when that digest differs from these questions', once per list (ask then keeps the digest asked for); a day Control Center could not read the standing asks nothing and records nothing. An answer-piece session marks a question shipped, {url, shipped_at}, only once it has read the published answer piece live on one of the domains (jobs/answer.md); the engine never sets it, tells AEO of the shipped list once each time it changes, and records that in shipped_sent.
